### The problem

Since 2022.5 I have the following error in the log:

2022-05-07 11:11:36 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.sensor] Error while setting up onvif platform for sensor
...
OverflowError: date value out of range


Full log added bellow

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.5.2

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2022.4.7

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

### Integration causing the issue

ONVIF

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/onvif/

logger:

Then I noticed this line:
`2022-06-01 16:20:25 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.onvif] Device date/time: 2022-06-01 14:20:23+00:00 | System date/time: 2022-06-01 14:20:22.816183+00:00`

Could it have to do something with device date/time notations with microseconds?

If I removed this if statement everything is working again (line 404 and 405 in /usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/sensor/__init__.py):
```
                if value.tzinfo != timezone.utc:
                    value = value.astimezone(timezone.utc)
```

The only thing I don't know is what I am maybe messing up in other sensors by removing this line.

```
if value.tzinfo != timezone.utc:
